metadata.description: Marketplace hosting two forecasting skills: superforecasting (turn fuzzy questions into testable probabilities and track them to settlement) and reference-class-forecasting (correct optimism bias with base rates from comparable finished cases).

plugins.name: forecasting-skills
plugins.description: 两个预测类 Agent Skill：① superforecasting 超预测——把模糊问题变成可检验的数字概率并长期跟踪校准（10 步流程 / 四出口准入 / 费米分解 / 外部视角 / C+ 锚定 / Brier 记分闭环）；② reference-class-forecasting 参考类预测——用同类已完结案例的统计分布修正内部估计的乐观偏差。
